Neutral controls such as a68f480c04f4dafbdb6d were much closer than the major polar and heteroatom failures, so this batch adds controls around the tail probes while focusing local contrasts on loading-sensitive and topology-specific families.","batch_rationale":"The batch combines matched m159, m53, m72, m39, and m117 condition-response experiments with high-width donor, nitro, nitrile, fused-aromatic, and multifunctional carbonyl points. The matched pairs and triplet reduce ambiguity between ratio, loading amount, and loading solvent; the high-width points repair regions where measured V1/V2 errors have been largest; and the neutral, ester, aldehyde, and halogenated controls constrain transfer into the central Row-distribution. This combination should improve generalization by teaching the retrained model when V2 tails are real, when they are scaffold-specific, and when a broad polar correction should be withheld."}
